themes_detail.label: Tree Branches Hazard Spike
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree and branch complaints exploded to 14 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 0.6 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 2140% spike (z-score: 19.22)—signaling a sudden public safety or maintenance crisis in parks and streets across Crown Heights.
evidence: 14 overgrown tree/branch complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (8-week baseline)
z-score of 19.22 indicates extremely rare statistical event
2140% increase suggests sudden weather event, storm damage, or deferred maintenance becoming visible
reporting_angles: Did a recent storm damage trees across the district? Interview Parks Dept on cleanup timeline.
Investigate whether Parks Dept backlog in tree maintenance is finally surfacing as public complaints.
Canvass Prospect Heights and Crown Heights parks to visually document hazardous branches; safety risk to pedestrians?

themes_detail.label: Homeless Assistance Surge
themes_detail.summary: Homeless Person Assistance complaints spiked to 26 LAST WEEK versus a 2.8 per-week baseline (846% increase, z-score: 12.54), aligning with repeated community board funding requests for homeless services and street outreach expansion.
evidence: 26 homeless assistance complaints last week vs. 2.8 weekly average (8-week baseline)
Community Board budget requests repeatedly cite 'expand street outreach' and 'facilities for homeless' as unfunded priorities
Suggests either increased visible homelessness or residents losing patience with encampments
reporting_angles: Interview residents and local merchants on where encampments are concentrated; has density shifted recently?
File FOIL for DHS street outreach deployment data—are crews responding adequately to the district?
Talk to advocates and service providers: Is this a seasonal influx, or sign of systemic shortfall in shelter/services?

themes_detail.label: Street/Sidewalk Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints surged to 73 LAST WEEK versus 18.9 per-week baseline (287% spike, z-score: 4.44), alongside commercial noise complaints at 49 three weeks ago (114% above baseline), indicating emerging quality-of-life conflict in commercial corridors.
evidence: Street/sidewalk noise: 73 complaints last week vs. 18.9 weekly average—287% increase (z-score: 4.44)
Commercial noise: 49 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 22.9 weekly average—114% increase (z-score: 4.35)
Combined signal suggests either new commercial activity, events, or construction concentration
reporting_angles: Map the 311 noise complaints geographically: Are they clustered on Atlantic Ave, Flatbush Ave, or residential blocks?
Investigate whether new bars, restaurants, or venues have recently opened or expanded; NYSLA permit activity?
Interview residents on timing: Is this weekend activity, late-night music venues, or daytime construction?

themes_detail.label: Maintenance & Facility Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Maintenance or Facility complaints jumped to 16 THIS WEEK versus 3.9 per-week baseline (313% spike, z-score: 7.17), suggesting accelerating deterioration in public buildings or parks infrastructure that aligns with Community Board requests for park building upgrades.
evidence: 16 maintenance/facility complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.9 weekly average (8-week baseline)—313% increase (z-score: 7.17)
Community Board has standing budget request: 'Reconstruct or upgrade a building in a park' (Department of Parks and Recreation)
May indicate deferred maintenance becoming critical or newly visible damage
reporting_angles: FOIL Parks Dept for list of facilities with open maintenance tickets in Crown Heights/Prospect Heights.
Identify which specific parks/buildings are generating complaints; visit to document conditions.
Interview Parks Dept on funding constraints: Are staffing shortages delaying repairs?

themes_detail.label: Dead Animal & Sanitation Uptick
themes_detail.summary: Dead Animal complaints jumped to 6 LAST WEEK versus 1.2 per-week baseline (380% spike, z-score: 4.91), and Unsanitary Condition spiked to 121 complaints three weeks ago (109% above baseline), signaling possible pest infestation, waste management, or environmental health concerns.
evidence: Dead Animal: 6 complaints last week vs. 1.2 weekly average—380% increase (z-score: 4.91)
Unsanitary Condition: 121 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 57.9 weekly average—109% increase (z-score: 5.96)
Combined spike suggests possible rodent/pest outbreak or garbage management failure
reporting_angles: Interview Sanitation and Health Dept: Are they tracking unusual rat/pest activity in the district?
Canvass areas with high complaint density to document visible sanitation/pest issues; photo evidence.
Talk to residents and business owners: Have they noticed increased rodents, flies, or odors in the past 2–3 weeks?
